text:
maria: quick follow-up from the postmortem — last night's KV OOMs (rgn-us-east) look like a recurring fragmentation pattern on slab-3. collecting remediation steps and owners.

jon: can we confirm correlation with the prefix-cache warmup? i saw a spike at ~02:14 UTC.

devin: yes, prefix warmup + simultaneous heavy short-lived keys. logs show `kv_residency: growth_rate=12.3% slab3_frag=78%`.

liz: ownership proposal: profiling & heap snapshots -> @devin; GC/shard limit tuning -> @rahul; detection and alerting -> @liz. timeline: snapshot by EOD, GC PR by tomorrow.

rahul: plan to try conservative GC changes + lower shard reserve on canary to 0.6. quick runbook: 
```
- set KV_SHARD_RESERVE=0.6
- enable incremental_slab_gc=true
- run `heap-prof --target=slab3 --duration=2m`
```

devin: collected heap-snap at 176543+170s, uploaded to s3://redwood-debug/kv-snapshots/1765439999.prof (compressed).

maria: tickets to track: INC-4872 (postmortem), TKT-1192 (profiling harness), GH#4521 (slab-gc adjustments).

jon: note for retro — pattern matches 2024-03-14 (small-allocation storm preventing free coalescing). adding "fragmentation-pattern" tag to INC-4872.

liz: concrete action items & owners:
- profiling & raw heap-snap: @devin (EOD)
- GC tuning PR + canary: @rahul (24h)
- automated detection rule (flag eviction/frag): @liz (48h)
- follow-up retro & checklist update: @maria (next-week all-hands)

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary patched to GC sweep v2 at 1765440100 :rotating_light:

devin: suggestion — add a local perf harness that churns many tiny keys to reproduce fragmentation; I'll sketch in TKT-1192.

maria: also propose a temporary soft-limit on prefix-cache entries (10k entries/shard) to damp rapid warmups while we validate GC changes.

rahul: early canary numbers: memory growth down ~18% on patched canary nodes, still validating tail latency and eviction churn.

liz: please attach canary graphs and heap diffs when stable; i'll coordinate alert updates.

jon: will track PRs and close action items as they merge. thanks everyone — ping here for blockers. :eyes:
